label: Now Developing
items: The PNP opened a nationwide hunt after Senator Bato dela Rosa's surrender week ended without him turning himself in.
The Supreme Court told Congress to comment on the lowered conviction-vote rule, and watchdogs flagged a ₱4.38-billion DPWH jump for Sandro Marcos's district.
The peso broke ₱64 as Marcos told the public not to panic, while ASEAN defense ministers met in Cebu as the AFP counted 54 Chinese ships in the West Philippine Sea.
